page.overview:
Who is Marta?

Marta was a cursed human and Jakob Ornstine's wife before he killed her.

When Marta was 10, she would travel around her village and sell pastries, singing as she went, while being secretly followed by Jakob. As she grew older, Jakob fell in love with her, though she did not feel the same way. However, Marta's father sold her into marriage to Jakob for 21 silver coins and seven fox skins. Jakob was immediately abusive and would force himself upon her and beat her, all while telling her it was love. Marta also became aware that Jakob was inventing his own stories of them having a wonderful life together, a far cry from the reality.

Marta's only moments of peace were when she'd go collect seashells, as she saw them as telling the story of another world and wonderful lives elsewhere, free from the abuse she was going through. One day, Jakob destroyed some of her precious seashells as he wanted to have a new dagger created with them inlaid into the hilt. For this, he then sent Marta to put the order in with the blacksmith, Talton.

On arriving at the blacksmith's, the two immediately fell for each other and Marta began to frequently visit Talton under the pretense of checking on the dagger's progress, unaware that Jakob was getting suspicious. About three weeks into their affair, Jakob caught the two having a tryst on the beach and Jakob slaughtered Talton. However, Jakob fell into a further delusion and began to tell people Marta was instead attacked by a sea monster that nearly dragged her into the sea and the marks she bore were from it, instead of having been lover's marks left behind by Talton.
